description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'LicenseSearchFilterParams' used for filter parameters in license search functionality within the OrangeHRM admin module. It extends a base 'FilterParams' class and sets a default sort field.

classes.name: LicenseSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for holding license search filter parameters, including allowed sort fields and default sorting behavior.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a default sort field 'l.name'.
